invariants.rationale: The method operates on preppedInputRecord, which is passed to bulkInsert; it may be required to be non-null.
instantTime is used in an exception message and passed to bulkInsert, so it should not be null.
table is used as an argument to bulkInsert and may be required.
config is passed to bulkInsert and likely required.
userDefinedBulkInsertPartitioner is passed to bulkInsert; could be null but check for acceptability.
